segments.an7.85:1.1: [mahāni.18; cūḷani. ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa 8]“Sattannaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ bhinnattā bhikkhu hoti.
segments.an7.85:1.3: Sakkāyadiṭṭhi bhinnā hoti, vicikicchā bhinnā hoti, sīlabbataparāmāso bhinno hoti, rāgo bhinno hoti, doso bhinno hoti, moho bhinno hoti, māno bhinno hoti.
segments.an7.85:1.4: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ bhinnattā bhikkhu hotī”ti.
